_how_to_update: Your hand-picked products for the homepage 'Our picks' tab. Add NOTHS product links (www.notonthehighstreet.com/<brand>/product/<name>) to items, with an optional one-line blurb. Set expires a few weeks out: after that date the tab hides itself. Image, name and price come from the Awin feed on the next site build; out-of-stock products are skipped. The tab only shows with 2 or more products.
title: Our picks

_example_item.blurb: Optional one-liner shown under the price.
